description: This file defines the `GatewayConnectionController` class responsible for managing connections to gateways within the application. It handles discovery, connection setup (automatic/manual), TLS fingerprint verification, and permissions gathering. It includes methods for resolving service endpoints, building URLs, and maintaining connection state, as well as supporting classes for TLS fingerprint probing.

classes.name: GatewayTLSFingerprintProbe
classes.description: A helper class to asynchronously probe TLS certificate fingerprint from a server endpoint via a WebSocket connection, handling hostname validation and fingerprint extraction.
